title: Lessons with Merle Johnson and the Cotton Club break replacing Duke
summary: Following Cab's lead, Thomas studies saxophone with Merle Johnson; the band gets the Cotton Club job when Duke Ellington goes to film Three Little Words.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: And he was influential in me taking saxophone lessons. He was sitting back one day with an alto saxophone. I said, "Man, what you doin' with a saxophone?" He said, "I'm taking lessons." He done gone and bought him a Selmer alto and went to Merle Johnson to take lessons. I found out who Merle Johnson, and I went down there to take lessons. And I'll never forget it. I saw Joe Garland one day, and he said, "Man, what are you doing going down to take lessons? You gonna turn legit?" I said, "No, I'm just trying to learn how to get a good tone, man." I knew my tone was just so-so. Because that tone that Lawson...my teacher...a trombone player...

Dawson! That damn thing stayed in my ear for years, because it was so beautiful. And I just always wanted to get a good tone. It just stayed with me. So I down and studied with Merle, and he started to show me how to blow(?) it. And I got Brown interested.
